mapper.select: SELECT id, stock_code, corp_code, business_year, report_code, base_date, close_price, issued_shares, distributed_shares, market_cap, free_float_market_cap, revenue, operating_income, net_income, total_assets, total_liabilities, total_equity, per, pbr, psr, roe, roa, debt_ratio, operating_margin, net_margin, revenue_growth_rate, operating_income_growth_rate, net_income_growth_rate, profitability_score, stability_score, growth_score, valuation_score, total_score, calculated_at, created_at, updated_at FROM stock_fundamental_indicator WHERE stock_code = #{stockCode} ORDER BY calculated_at DESC, business_year DESC, report_code DESC LIMIT 1
